canonical_facts: The man is illiterate and borrows books for his child, who has difficulty walking
The child marks page thirty after finishing each book
The father checks for that mark before borrowing
A marked copy is rejected in favor of another book to avoid repeats
unknown_details: The child’s gender, diagnosis, mark color and exact symbol are unspecified.
explicit_negatives: The father cannot read; the child reads the borrowed books.
The mark is on page thirty after reading, not a page-number mistake or a catalog code.
irrelevant_details: Unspecified names, brands, colors and exact dates are incidental.
